title: 1963 Kenneth Nicholson opened a Save Easy, later owned by Leighton Ellis in 1969, before it was the Red & White Grocer
description: In September 1963, it was announced that Ken Nicholson had purchased the property of H. E. Adams, a home considered one of Hartland’s oldest buildings, which was demolished to make way for a Red & White grocery store affiliated with Atlantic Wholesalers. On October 18, 1969, Ellis and Shaw dissolved their partnership; Gerald Shaw opened the Handy Andy Store, while Leighton Ellis established a Save Easy in late October, which had formerly been the IGA on Main Street. Ellis managed the Save Easy grocery store until 1975. Lona Pelkey then took over the Red & White grocery store, which was destroyed by fire in 1981.
